mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% signals economic weakness that triggers risk-off behavior, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate collapsing consumer demand, triggering recession fears and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing production growth below 0.5% signals industrial contraction that reduces corporate earnings visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) accelerates capital allocation to equities, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 5.0% signals labor market tightness that may trigger Fed rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing production (INDPRO) falling below 100.0 signals industrial contraction that increases recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0.
